brief.question: How does Everything's file search work (index, search syntax, result columns, sorting, status bar) so a similar Rust/egui app can be built?
brief.purpose: Rebuild a similar desktop file-search app with the same core features
brief.done_when: MECHANICS.md lists columns, search modifiers, sort rules, status text with sources; app builds and screenshots.

findings.statement: Built-in filters: Everything, Audio, Compressed, Document, Executable, Folder, Picture, Video, each defined as an ext: list (or folder:) in sub_1400c15c0; size keywords empty/tiny/small/medium/large/huge/gigantic use thresholds 10 KB, 100 KB, 1 MB, 16 MB, 128 MB (sub_140055200, data 0x1401fed10); size units are powers of 1024 and a unit value matches a 1 KB-wide band.

Search syntax (help text 0x1401c81e0): space=AND, |=OR, !=NOT, < > grouping, "" phrase, * and ? wildcards; modifiers case:, diacritics:, file:, folder:, path:, regex:, wholeword:/ww:, wfn:, startwith:, endwith: with no- prefix to disable; functions ext:, size:, dm:/dc:, infolder:, len:, count:, dupe:, empty:; macros audio: zip: doc: exe: pic: video:. Status bar formats '%s objects' and '%s objects selected'; default columns Name, Path, Size, Date Modified.

The original's window is about 1000x720 inside the frame, titled '<search> - Everything', with menus File/Edit/View/Search/Bookmarks/Tools/Help, a full-width search box (filter box hidden), Name (~440 px) and Path (~505 px) columns visible, a caret above the sorted header and a grey tint on the sorted column; it accepts -search and -sort on the command line.

handoff:
State: Quickfind (Rust/eframe 0.31) in app/ builds and passes build + screenshot checks. Indexes all fixed drives with a parallel folder walk (3.18M entries in ~5-25 s), saves %LOCALAPPDATA%\Quickfind\index.bin in name order (reload ~0.6-1 s), rescans at start, live-updates via notify. Searches 10-130 ms on 3.2M entries; peak RAM ~400-480 MB (names in one shared block). Search syntax, filters, size bands and dates follow MECHANICS.md (sub_140116168, sub_140055200, sub_1400c15c0, help 0x1401c81e0). Bookmarks, export (.efu), -search/-filter/-sort/-case/-matchpath options, hidden --build-index timing mode.
Toolchain trap: no MSVC/SDK on this PC -> app/rust-toolchain.toml pins stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu; .cargo/config.toml adds -LC:/Windows/System32 for shlwapi; Cargo.lock pins arboard 3.4.1, winapi-util 0.1.9, parking_lot 0.12.3/core 0.9.10, libloading 0.8.6, chrono 0.4.39, webbrowser 1.0.1 to avoid raw-dylib (bundled dlltool needs a missing assembler). Don't `cargo update` blindly.
Open: size column format (unk_e72dcc78fb827825, blocked: original never finishes loading its DB without admin). Column widths deliberately 340/380 (original ~440/505 with Size/Date scrolled off). Not done: NTFS MFT/USN reading, content:/media functions, multiple windows, ETP/HTTP servers.
Next ideas: Options window (remember columns/widths, hide system/hidden files, exclude folders), match highlighting in results.
